focus: Find your levels and learn the movements
coach_note: Monday is your baseline assessment. Wednesday and Friday: pick the level you found on Monday. Finish every set feeling like you could do 3-4 more reps.
Same plan, smoother reps. If every set reached 12 clean reps in two sessions, move up one level.
A third set is new. It is fine if your reps drop a little on the last set.
Fewer sets, easier effort, no level-ups. Take your time on the cool-down. You should finish feeling fresh.
New tempo: lower for 3 slow seconds on every rep. It makes each level harder, so reps may drop at first.
Push a little closer: finish sets with about 2 reps left in the tank.
Most volume of the program. Keep form perfect; stop a set early before it gets sloppy.
Back off on purpose. You are not losing progress; you are letting it sink in.
New rep range (5-8). If you can do more than 8 at your current level, move up a level now.
Rest fully between sets (90-120 s). Quality reps beat more reps.
Your hardest week. Stop each set with about 1 good rep left. Never grind through bad form.
Mon and Wed are short and easy so you are fresh. Friday is your retest: compare with Week 1 and celebrate.
